tools.name: read_audit_calendar
tools.description: Read the Q1 Schedule worksheet of the Audit Calendar 2026 spreadsheet to find the next full-scope Q1 audit window, owner, and status.

tools.name: read_scheduling_policies
tools.description: Read the scheduling policies tab (freeze periods, minimum window, overlap and announcement-approval rules) before proposing any audit dates.

tools.name: read_audit_log
tools.description: Read the existing Audit Log 2026 spreadsheet to see prior and current-quarter audit entries and the column structure.

tools.name: read_compliance_project_structure
tools.description: Read the Asana Compliance 2026 project to identify the Q1 section, available tags, and existing tasks so the new task can be placed correctly.

tools.name: analyze_schedule_conflicts
tools.description: Cross-check the candidate full-scope audit window against the scheduling policies and existing audit entries to flag freeze-period, window-length, or owner-overlap conflicts.

tools.name: draft_audit_task_proposal
tools.description: Compose a draft proposal for the 'Q1 Ops Audit' task (proposed name, target section, tag, start/end dates, owner, the audit-log row to be added, and the #ops-updates announcement text) for the user to review and approve.

tools.name: create_asana_audit_task
tools.description: Create the 'Q1 Ops Audit' task in the Asana Compliance 2026 project, add it to the Q1 section, and apply the Audit tag.

tools.name: append_audit_log_row
tools.description: Append a new row recording the Q1 Ops Audit to the Audit Log 2026 spreadsheet.

tools.name: post_ops_updates_announcement
tools.description: Post the audit announcement message to the #ops-updates Slack channel, notifying all 148 channel members.

tools.name: read_team_directory
tools.description: Look up operations team members, roles, and the designated announcement approver.

tools.name: read_ops_channel_metadata
tools.description: Read metadata about the #ops-updates Slack channel (audience, member count, purpose) without posting anything.
